entries.title: About jspassgen | Security Architecture and Principles
entries.content: Skip to main content jspassgen v0.0.19 GitHub Toggle colour theme About jspassgen jspassgen was created to solve a persistent vulnerability in modern authentication workflows: the reliance on proprietary, cloud-hosted, and telemetry-heavy password generators. Design Principles Zero External Dependencies: The core generator library contains zero third-party packages, preventing software supply chain compromises. Local Trust Boundary: Passwords never touch a network socket. All entropy is derived from hardware noise via operating system CSPRNG interfaces. NIST SP 800-63B Compliance: Full adherence to modern digital identity guidelines, discouraging arbitrary composition rules in favour of length and entropy. Post-Quantum Preparedness: Hardened key derivation primitives designed to resist future quantum acceleration. Author & Maintainer Created and maintained by Sebastien Rousseau. Dual licensed under Apache-2.0 and MIT.

Partial✗Not supported: Outdated rules~Partial: Partial✗Not supported: Incompatible✗Not supported: NoneEngineering ExcellenceDesigned for Cryptographic Rigour jspassgen was engineered because legacy password generators still enforce obsolete 1990s composition rules instead of measuring true entropy. ⚛Post-Quantum Resistance Leveraging memory-hard KDF derivation based on Argon2id principles to protect secrets against Grover quantum search algorithms and massively parallel ASIC cracking arrays. 🎲EFF Diceware Wordlists Generates memorable multi-word passphrases using the Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) curated dictionary of 7,776 words, yielding 12.92 bits of cryptographic entropy per word. 🍯Juels-Rivest Honeywords Active breach detection mechanism that generates authentic-looking decoy passwords alongside the master key. If a decoy is entered, an alert triggers before the master key is compromised. 📐True Shannon Entropy Calculates information-theoretic Shannon entropy $H(X) = -\sum p(x) \log_2 p(x)$ across the symbol distribution, rather than simply multiplying character count by a constant. ⚡Zero Dependencies Pure standard library implementation. The core engine has zero third-party dependencies, eliminating supply-chain vulnerabilities, bloated lockfiles, and telemetry leaks. 🛡Local-First Trust Boundary Every cryptographic operation executes inside your local browser or terminal process. No passwords, seeds, or telemetry bytes ever traverse the network.
